subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox support Cloud Run Sandbox as a built-in provider while Google’s service is in public preview and operators must deploy and secure a durable-routing gateway?
rationale: The code fits the provider adapter boundary and has meaningful live proof, but neither tests nor contributor implementation can decide the long-term support commitment, preview-API exposure, and credentialed gateway contract.

options.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
options.body: Accept the public-preview and gateway support boundary, remove the release-owned changelog lines, and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Defer built-in support
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it by maintainer choice until Cloud Run Sandbox or its gateway contract reaches the desired support maturity.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
recommendation.body: Accept the public-preview and gateway support boundary, remove the release-owned changelog lines, and continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent lifecycle hardening commits make this the best available owner signal for the provider’s support and safety contract.
